name: InsertChat
author: insertchat.com

sections.description:
InsertChat adds a branded AI assistant to your WordPress site in minutes. Connect your approved pages, docs, FAQs, policies, product information, and support knowledge, then give visitors a direct way to ask questions, find answers, capture intent, and reach your team.

Your website already holds useful answers. InsertChat makes those answers easier to ask for, easier to trust, and easier to act on without rebuilding your WordPress theme, search, navigation, or CMS.

Learn more on the InsertChat website:

  • WordPress AI chat widget
  • Features
  • Pricing
  • Security
  • Agency white-label assistants
  • API

What InsertChat helps you do

Answer visitor questions from approved sources

Train your assistant on the WordPress pages, documentation, FAQs, policies, product details, help content, and other sources your team already maintains. Visitors get answers grounded in your material instead of hunting through menus or leaving for search.

Keep the experience on brand

Customize the assistant experience so it fits your site and business. InsertChat is built for teams that care about brand control, polished visitor experience, and ownership of the customer journey.

Capture leads and visitor intent

Turn serious questions into qualified leads. InsertChat can collect contact details and context while the visitor is already explaining what they need.

Route support when AI should not answer alone

Use InsertChat to deflect common questions and guide visitors toward the right next step. When a person needs help from your team, the assistant can support handoff workflows with conversation context.

Improve content discovery

Help visitors find the article, guide, resource, product, policy, or answer they came for. InsertChat gives your content a conversational path without replacing your site structure.

Learn what visitors cannot find

Use conversation history, analytics, and insights to see what people ask, where your content is unclear, and which questions create support or conversion opportunities.

Support ecommerce and product discovery

Guide shoppers through product questions, policies, comparisons, buying resources, and support content so they can move from confused browsing to confident next steps.

Serve agencies and client sites

Agencies and implementers can deploy assistants for client websites and manage branded AI experiences through InsertChat. Learn more about InsertChat for agencies.

Connect your tools

Use InsertChat integrations, API access, and automation workflows to bring assistant conversations into the systems your team already uses. Explore the InsertChat API.

Popular use cases

  • AI chat widget for WordPress
  • Website assistant trained on your content
  • Customer support deflection
  • Lead capture and qualification
  • Ecommerce product discovery
  • Help center and FAQ assistant
  • Content discovery for blogs, publishers, education, and resource libraries
  • Agency client assistants
  • White-label AI chatbot delivery
  • Branded visitor support workflows

Easy Setup

Step 1: Install the Plugin

  • Install InsertChat from the WordPress plugin repository.
  • Activate the plugin on your WordPress site.

Step 2: Create an InsertChat Account

  • Sign up for a free InsertChat account. No credit card or coding needed.

Step 3: Configure Your AI Chatbot

  • Create your first AI chatbot and get your unique AI chatbot ID.
  • Customize the chatbot’s look to match your brand.

Step 4: Embed the Chatbot

  • Enter your AI Chatbot ID in the plugin settings.

Step 5: Engage with Your Customers

  • Your InsertChat chatbot is now live! Start helping visitors right away.
  • Monitor performance through the detailed analytics in your dashboard.

  • Security: Review InsertChat security

sections.faq:
How do I start using the InsertChat plugin?

  1. Install the InsertChat plugin on your WordPress website.
  2. Sign up for an account at InsertChat.
  3. Create and customize your first AI Chatbot at InsertChat.
  4. Retrieve the AI chatbot ID from the “Playground” > “Install” page of your newly created AI chatbot.
  5. Return to your WordPress website and go to “InsertChat AI” in the dashboard sidebar.
  6. Paste your AI Chatbot ID into the designated field.
  7. Click “Save Changes” to activate your AI Chatbot seamlessly.
  8. Clear any caching mechanisms (Cloudflare, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, …).
  9. Visit your website to ensure your AI chatbot bubble loads correctly.
  10. Continuously tweak, customize, and train your AI chatbot for optimal performance.
